scope: Branch tip: the paired ObfuscationOS boots native userland on all ten profiles against the debug SDK in both fork configurations, and admits and links the release SDK on all ten.
claims: ObfuscationOS boots native userland on all ten profiles (qemu-distro --require-native), default and eager fallback
posix-check passes OK_VM_FORK_COPY and OK_VM_QUOTA and maps past the former 1024-record bound on all ten
Default builds report OK_NATIVE_COW with shared, copied and in-place resolved pages; fallback builds report none
ObfuscationOS kernel-sdk-check and distro_image pass against the ABI 75 release SDK on all ten profiles
